policy.note: The ordinary integrity gate enforces the proved ported, compiled, and verified floors. --milestone M3 independently enforces the historical 80-symbol target, now satisfied by reviewed M5 foundation work.

symbols.name: Box

symbols.name: OverlayHandle
gaps: The public rank-3 OverlayHandle covers hide, temporary visibility, focus, unfocus, and focus-state behavior, but Rust's OverlayUnfocus argument and retained handle identity are not the canonical optional JavaScript options/object boundary, and no NAPI export exists.

symbols.name: OverlayMargin
gaps: Rust models four required i64 fields defaulting to zero plus OverlayMargins::All for the numeric union; canonical fields are optional JavaScript numbers with different coercion and object semantics, and no NAPI mapping exists.

symbols.name: OverlayUnfocusOptions

symbols.name: TUI
gaps: The object-safe rank-2 Tui trait and rank-3 TuiBaseController cover shared lifecycle, focus, overlays, listener dispatch, queries, and scheduling, and reviewed injected Rust Main/Alt controllers build on that foundation. Tui is not a Component supertrait, and direct Rust lacks canonical mutable children, terminal, onDebug, and Promise-query property shapes; the M5 adapter supplies the production host/event loop and JavaScript facade.

symbols.name: TuiInputListener
gaps: Rust retains callback identity and live Set-style ordering and reentrancy, but uses a valid-UTF-8 borrowed Rust callback rather than exact JavaScript function/string identity or NAPI.

symbols.name: TuiInputListenerResult
gaps: Outer Option plus TuiInputListenerResult models undefined/pass, consume, and transform, but consume is a required bool and data is Option<String>, not the canonical optional JavaScript object/string/coercion identity, and no NAPI mapping exists.

symbols.name: TuiMode
gaps: Rust exposes Regular and Fullscreen variants and both injected Main/Alt controller modes are oracle-exercised; the exact JavaScript string union and NAPI boundary remain absent.

symbols.name: TuiStopOptions
gaps: Rust uses a required preserve_screen bool with a false default rather than the canonical optional preserveScreen JavaScript property object, and no NAPI mapping exists.

symbols.name: ViewportTUI
gaps: The ViewportTui trait, TuiBaseController layout-root behavior, and injected Rust Alt controller are reviewed. Direct Rust lacks the canonical VIEWPORT_TUI symbol brand and JavaScript interface; the M5 adapter supplies isViewportTUI, the public type facade, and production host event loop.

symbols.name: TuiAltScreen
gaps: The injected Rust TuiAltScreen covers the pinned 0.84.1 lifecycle, alternate-buffer, layout-root, focus/overlay, scroll/mouse/selection, image ownership, and teardown corpus. It still uses injected runtime and terminal seams rather than the canonical JavaScript class; the M5 adapter supplies ProcessTerminal/task pumping, JavaScript identity, package exposure, and current-consumer execution.

symbols.name: TuiAltScreenOptions
gaps: Wheel, mouse, URL-open, and right-click callback behavior is exercised through typed Rust options, but Rust callback ownership and numeric/value coercion are not the canonical optional JavaScript object or NAPI boundary.

symbols.name: TuiMainScreen
gaps: The injected Rust TuiMainScreen covers the pinned 0.84.1 lifecycle, differential render, resize, cursor, Kitty ownership, render-state, and teardown corpus plus real tmux execution. It still uses injected runtime and terminal seams rather than the canonical JavaScript class; the M5 adapter supplies ProcessTerminal/task pumping, JavaScript identity, package exposure, and current-consumer execution.
